capabilities: Search vault with hybrid semantic and keyword ranking
Show results as a similarity map
Find notes similar to the current note
Filter results by tag, folder, property, and date
Extract text from images with OCR
extras: Fork of Obsidian-Seek; the original does not accept outside contributions. GPU (WebGPU) indexing is much faster than the CPU fallback, and Linux users may need launch flags to enable WebGPU. First index downloads a ~100 MB model plus runtime (needs internet once, then works offline). Supports 52 languages plus code. Writes local diagnostic logs inside the vault. References external guides for the original Seek docs, WebGPU on Linux, and developer build instructions.
intentEvidence: Seeker is a fork of Obsidian-Seek by Ryan Manor, maintained by nickolaykondratyev
motivation: The fork was started to add Canvas and image OCR support and to flag clearly when indexing is not using the GPU, since the original does not take outside contributions.
problem: Obsidian's keyword search misses notes when you don't remember the exact words, leaving buried notes in large vaults hard to find.

relations.evidence: Seeker is a fork of Obsidian-Seek by Ryan Manor

summary: Hybrid search plugin combining semantic and keyword retrieval to find notes, Canvas, and images in your vault with an on-device embedding model.
